External pull requests are not accepted during the initial preview. Please open a reproducible issue instead. Unsolicited pull requests may be closed without review. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

For maintainer changes or an explicitly invited contribution:

- Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior.
- Record meaningful local tests and real-app checks separately.
- Note privacy, permissions, clipboard ownership and distribution implications.
- Update the relevant guide and Unreleased changelog.
- Verify provenance and GPL compatibility of imported code.
